description:
*** DEREK DORGAN AUCTIONEER (021)4871777 (086)0483003 ***

No.8 The Brambles is a spacious four-bedroom detached family residence with a large rear garden, which may allow for further future potential. 
This home offers bright, generously apportioned accommodation plus a highly desirable front southerly aspect.  

Occupying a prime position in this mature established estate, whilst benefiting from an exceptional family friendly setting, with a large open green area within close proximity plus Ballincollig Rugby club at the entrance of this estate.

Accommodation consists of Lounge, guest W/C, Living Room and large kitchen/dining room on the ground floor. With three double bedrooms, one single bedroom, one en-suite and the main bathroom on the first floor
